title: Apply for undergraduate graduation
description: Apply through the college and Registrar; the university certifies completion.
descriptionAr: قدّم عبر الكلية وعمادة القبول والتسجيل، والجامعة هي التي تعتمد إكمال الدرجة.
verificationNote: Use the current official page for portal labels, applicable term and eligibility. This checklist does not submit a request or verify your private university record. Published effective-2018 procedure; an application is not confirmation of graduation.
verificationNoteAr: تحقق من المسميات والفصل والأهلية في الصفحة الرسمية الحالية. لا ترسل هذه القائمة الطلب ولا تتحقق من سجلك الجامعي الخاص.
scopeNote: Published effective-2018 procedure; an application is not confirmation of graduation.

steps.title: Check applicability
steps.instruction: Check applicability: the published AE-06 procedure is for undergraduates outside Medicine and Health Sciences, not postgraduate or medical degrees.
steps.instructionAr: تحقق من انطباق الإجراء: يخص AE-06 البكالوريوس خارج كلية الطب والعلوم الصحية ولا يثبت قواعد الطب أو الدراسات العليا.

steps.title: Find your term’s last day to withdraw/drop without failure
steps.titleAr: حدد آخر يوم للانسحاب أو الحذف دون رسوب للفصل المطلوب
steps.instruction: Find your term’s last day to withdraw/drop without failure: the calendar supplies the date; it does not separately label it a graduation-application deadline.
steps.instructionAr: حدد آخر يوم للانسحاب أو الحذف دون رسوب للفصل المطلوب: يبين التقويم التاريخ ولا يسميه بصورة منفصلة موعداً لطلب التخرج.

steps.title: Submit by the procedure’s deadline
steps.instruction: Submit by the procedure’s deadline: apply through the College Advising Unit and Registrar; the college confirms requirements and Registration certifies the award.
steps.instructionAr: قدّم ضمن موعد الإجراء: عبر وحدة الإرشاد الأكاديمي وعمادة القبول والتسجيل؛ تؤكد الكلية المتطلبات وتعتمد جهة التسجيل منح الدرجة.

sources.title: UAEU Degree Completion and Graduation Procedures
sources.sourceVersion: Effective 2018-08-12; review due 2021-09-01; no supersession certification
sources.sourceSection: Scope; procedures 4 Application for Degree and 5 Certification of Degree Completion
sources.evidenceText: Published effective-2018 undergraduate policy excludes the College of Medicine and Health Sciences; later supersession not established. AE-06 procedures 4–5: student must apply through College Advising Unit and Registrar by the term's last day to drop without failure. College confirms completion and Registrar certifies degree; application is not automatic confirmation of graduation.

sources.title: UAEU Academic Calendar
sources.evidenceText: The academic calendar labels 18 September 2026 (Fall 2026) and 5 February 2027 (Spring 2027) as the last day to withdraw and drop without failure. It does not separately label these as graduation-application deadlines. A scoped graduation deadline is derived only by combining those dates with AE-06 procedure 4, which requires the application by the last day to drop without failure. The calendar alone does not establish medical or postgraduate graduation-application rules.
